summary: Iter 216h22 (P5 Master Admin Integrations Hub) - 7/8 test items PASSED. Backend endpoint GET /api/master-admin/integrations-hub works correctly with auth gating and Pulse scope filtering. Frontend Hub page renders 4 cards (Stripe Connect, Sicon, Orbit 4, Sage 200) with status pills, summary strip, and drawer functionality. Sicon drawer shows all 5 tabs (Overview, Organisations, Event Log, Configuration, Field Mappings). Sage 200 drawer shows field mapping table and coverage line. Brand Picker works correctly for GymAxis admin (toggle visible). Pulse Master Admin scope-lock verified via backend API (brand='pulse', orgs_total=3 vs 90 total). Frontend Pulse admin test blocked by rate limiting but backend confirms correct behavior.

test_1_integrations_hub_endpoint.details: GET /api/master-admin/integrations-hub returns correct JSON with brand, integrations[4] (stripe_connect/sicon/orbit4/sage200), each with key/label/enabled/status/last_event_at/events_24h/errors_24h/orgs_configured/orgs_total/ref_field, and summary{connected,degraded,not_configured,total}. Returns 401 without token.

test_2_pulse_admin_scope.details: Pulse Master Admin (pulse.scope.test@pulsefitness.com) gets brand='pulse' and orgs_total=3 (only Pulse-visible orgs, not all 90). Backend correctly applies brand_filter_clause for Pulse scope.

test_3_sidebar_integrations_group.details: Integrations group in sidebar has 4 sub-tabs: Hub (default), Orbit 4, Sicon Service, Stripe Connect. Hub is the default landing for sidebar click.

test_4_hub_page_cards.details: Hub page at section=integrations-hub renders 4 cards with data-testids: integrations-hub-card-stripe_connect, -sicon, -orbit4, -sage200. Each card shows status pill, brand badge, org-coverage tile, last-24h tile. Summary strip shows 4 tiles (Connected/Degraded/Not configured/Brand scope).

test_5_sicon_drawer.details: Clicking Sicon card opens drawer (data-testid=integrations-hub-drawer-sicon) with embedded SiconIntegrationPage. All 5 sub-tabs present: sicon-tab-overview, sicon-tab-organisations, sicon-tab-logs, sicon-tab-config, sicon-tab-mappings. Field Mappings tab is reachable.

test_6_sage200_drawer.details: Clicking Sage 200 card opens drawer (data-testid=integrations-hub-sage-panel) showing field-mapping reference table (GymAxis field → Sage 200 field), Coverage line ('0 of 90 orgs have a Sage customer number configured'), and pointer to Org Billing tab.

test_7_brand_picker_lock.details: GymAxis Master Admin: Brand Picker trigger (data-testid=master-admin-brand-picker-trigger) IS rendered, locked pill NOT rendered - CORRECT. Pulse Master Admin: Backend confirms brand='pulse' scope. Frontend test blocked by rate limiting, but backend behavior verified via API. BrandPicker.js code review confirms isPulseAdmin prop forces brand='pulse' and renders locked pill with 'Pulse Fitness' label and 'Scope locked' chip.

test_8_regression.details: People Directory drawer, Customer Onboarding under Organisations group, and Organisation drawer 7 tabs were verified in previous iteration 216h21. No changes to these components in this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: BrandPicker.js correctly implements isPulseAdmin prop to force brand='pulse' and hide dropdown for Pulse admins
IntegrationsHub.js correctly passes isPulseAdmin prop from MasterAdminPage
Backend integrations-hub endpoint correctly uses brand_filter_clause to scope orgs_configured/orgs_total by Pulse brand
